जु r. 1st cl. (जवति)
 1. To go or move quickly, to go rapidly.
 E. भ्वा० प०
अक० अनिट् जुङ् (ङ) r. 1st cl. (जवते) To go or move. सौत्रधातुः आत्म०
सक० अनिट् ।

जू f. (-जूः)
 1. Æther, heaven.
 2. A name of the goddess

. A female demon or goblin.
 4. Speed, expedition, velocity.
 5.
Going, motion.
 6. The atmosphere
 E. जू to go swiftly, affix क्विप्,
and the final lengthened.
